prompt:
CONCEPT: the personification of Rust — the lord of the Rust House of the Iron Nation. A female character who IS that substance; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the substance’s traits, within the element’s own palette. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.
ELEMENT TRAITS of Iron (Fe) to carry in her design and the scene: dark grey iron with bright steel highlights, orange-brown rust and glowing forge-orange heat, magnetism (iron filings, lodestone), hardness and weight, the smell of a smithy; it is the element of tools, weapons, bridges, machines and blood. Palette: iron grey, steel silver, rust orange, ember red, black soot.
HOUSE TRAITS of Rust: flaking orange-brown rust over pitted dark iron, layered patina creeping over metal, worn leather straps, the look of something buried and dug up. Palette: rust orange, ochre, dark pitted iron, faded leather brown.
AGE: in her twenties — smooth youthful skin, soft full cheeks; minimal facial lines (no nasolabial folds, crow's feet, under-eye bags or cheek creases) and a soft smile that never creases her face.
SILHOUETTE: broad-shouldered and strong build; long braids; rust-orange hair.
FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): softly square face; deep-set eyes; sharp angled brows; straight narrow nose; thin long lips; rust-amber eyes.
WORLD — MECHA: year 2150, an orbital iron foundry over a red-dust asteroid: molten metal pouring in zero gravity into glowing molds, magnetic rails, stars and a distant sun, hard rim light. MECHA DESIGN: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. heavy dark-iron plating with brushed-steel edges, visible rivets and I-beam girder shapes in the pauldrons and greaves, a magnetic field drawn as hovering iron-filing arcs and a halo of orbiting shards, forge-orange glow lines along the seams, a rusted patina band across one shoulder, a back unit shaped like a blast-furnace crown.
STYLE: High-end stylized game CGI with coherent three-dimensional anatomy, physically convincing costume and prop construction, clean materials and dramatic production lighting. Preserve a designed character-art finish rather than live-action texture.
EXPOSURE (bold): her outer layer (coat, cloak, robe or armor) stays on both shoulders, worn symmetrically; skin shows through the inner garment — a deep open neckline with natural cleavage, a fitted corset-like waist, slits where the form allows. The collar opens with the neckline in a V or folds down, never standing away from the neck. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; keep the costume WORLD describes, material and palette.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no living creature, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
